ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Call To Win32_NTEventlogFile Class - PSScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the WMI class "Win32_NTEventlogFile" in a potentially suspicious way (delete, backup, change permissions, etc.) from a PowerShell script Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Win32\\_NTEventlogFile.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.BackupEventlog\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.ChangeSecurityPermissions\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.ChangeSecurityPermissionsEx\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.ClearEventLog\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.Delete\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.DeleteEx\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.Rename\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.TakeOwnerShip\\(.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.TakeOwnerShipEx\\(.*")))
